title: Business design
purpose: Introduce the concept and a practical way to apply it

slides.key_message: Business design connects customer value to sustainable business outcomes.
slides.notes: An introductory overview for business leaders and practitioners.
Business design looks beyond the offer itself. It considers whether people value the offer, whether the organization can reliably deliver it, and whether the economics can sustain it.

slides.key_message: A coherent business brings customer value, delivery, and economics together.

text.20:
CUSTOMER VALUE  Solve a meaningful customer need.
DELIVERY MODEL  Organize people, partners, and operations.
BUSINESS ECONOMICS  Create revenue and manage costs.

slides.notes: These dimensions are interdependent. A compelling proposition must be matched by capabilities and an economic model that can support its delivery.

slides.key_message: Business design uses an iterative learning loop.

text.15:
Understand needs
Frame the offer
Test demand and delivery
Learn and adapt

slides.notes: Treat the sequence as a learning loop, not a one-way handoff. Use evidence from customer conversations and practical tests to refine the offer, its delivery, and its economics.
